prerequisite: The target layout exists; rows are read from xlsx by project glue scripts (the node itself does not read xlsx and pulls in no third-party library)
assertions: horizontal lines = rows + 1, vertical lines = columns + 1, texts = non-empty cells; all carry XData C3DF_TBL:<name>
with a layout name in space the entities land in that layout's paper-space block (DXF 67=1 / 410=layout name); with Model they land in model space
with width given, column widths scale proportionally and the total == width (+/- 1e-6); without it widths are estimated from the longest text
rerun with the same name: cleared == previous entities, nothing stacks; different names do not clear each other
text wider than its cell gets WidthFactor reduced to avail/est (floor 0.5) so it does not overflow the grid
a non-existent layout name throws and names it; empty rows throws; missing x/y throws
a text_style not present in the drawing throws; by default the SimHei-convention style (see normalize_textstyles) is used when present, otherwise the drawing default
